name: d1Analytics
description: Read and write query counts, rows touched and query latency for a D1 database

postBody.query: query($accountTag:string!,$databaseId:string,$start:Time!,$end:Time!){viewer{accounts(filter:{accountTag:$accountTag}){d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups(limit:10000,filter:{databaseId:$databaseId,datetime_geq:$start,datetime_leq:$end},orderBy:[{{ (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 5400 ? 'datetimeMinute' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 46800 ? 'datetimeFiveMinutes' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 90000 ? 'datetimeFifteenMinutes' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 619200 ? 'datetimeHour' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 2764800 ? 'datetimeSixHours' : 'date' }}_ASC]){sum{readQueries writeQueries rowsRead rowsWritten queryBatchResponseBytes}quantiles{queryBatchTimeMsP50 queryBatchTimeMsP90 queryBatchTimeMsP99}dimensions{date: {{ (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 5400 ? 'datetimeMinute' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 46800 ? 'datetimeFiveMinutes' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 90000 ? 'datetimeFifteenMinutes' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 619200 ? 'datetimeHour' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 2764800 ? 'datetimeSixHours' : 'date' }}}}}}}
